title: 养雀笼 Yangque Long
subtitle: Yang Ch'iao Lung, Bird Cage · Xiyang Lou
children: small walled court north of 养雀笼

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: platform 0.5 m, eave 6 m, ridge 8 m above the ground

evidence.title: Plate VI: 养雀笼 Yangque Long, west
evidence.excerpt_other: on aperçoit sur la droite une pièce d'eau, où un vaisseau à l'européenne paroît faire naufrage.
evidence.summary: A portico rather than a house; low gallery on the left; columns on pedestals with bases and no capitals; a pond with what seems a European ship foundering, perhaps a painted or staged scene.

evidence.title: Plate VII: 养雀笼 Yangque Long, east
evidence.excerpt_other: En face de ce portique est une rivière, que l'on passe sur un pont garni de balustrades,
evidence.summary: An entry more than a dwelling; looks Greek at first; capitals, arch and niches compared with Borromini; balustrade on the entablature.

evidence.title: Engravings 6 and 7: 养雀笼 Yangque Long
evidence.excerpt_other: Water flowed from carved white marble fountains on both sides of the doorway.
evidence.summary: West front on the court behind 谐奇趣, with a passage east through the building. Peacocks until Jiaqing, per Lu. Plate p.146: being torn down about 1924.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: 圆明园遗址考古今年推进至大水法, 浙江在线
evidence.summary: 养雀笼 Yangque Long: 1,000 m2 cleared in 2015, showing foundations that combine 三合土 lime concrete with brick and stone. 大水法 and 远瀛观 were next, about 2,000 m2 planned for 2016, with the stated aim of learning how imperial buildings were founded, which standing buildings cannot show.

evidence.title: 揭秘圆明园考古, 华西都市报 via 中证网
evidence.locator: news, 张中华 and 张利芳
evidence.summary: Three large campaigns since 1996 yielded over 50,000 finds. The campaign from 2012 dug 桃花洞, 大宫门, 养雀笼, the 海晏堂 water tower and 远瀛观. At 如园 Ru Yuan, the best-preserved of these sites and the first imitation of a Jiangnan garden dug here (19,000 m2 site, 2,800 m2 buildings, 3,800 m2 opened), diggers found 芝兰室, 云萝山馆, 听泉榭, 延清堂, 含碧楼, 挹霞亭, 观丰榭, 引胜轩, rockery, paths and shores, and burnt famille-rose floor tiles in 延清堂.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.
